item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 23/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Prapiroon will move across Beibu Wan today. It will then move into the inland areas of Guangxi to the northern part of Vietnam and weaken gradually. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Gaemi will move in the general direction of the seas east of Taiwan and intensify significantly today and tomorrow. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, the weather will be very hot with a few thundery showers over Guangdong midweek this week. An active southwesterly airstream is expected to bring unsettled weather to the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. A broad trough of low pressure will affect the northern part of the South China Sea early next week.
